The full replication repository is at
[github.com/andreasalem/floods_france](https://github.com/andreasalem/floods_france).

## Data availability

The microdata are **confidential** and accessed through
[CASD](https://www.casd.eu/) (Centre d'accès sécurisé aux données). No microdata are or ever
will be in the repository.

| Source | Content | Access |
|---|---|---|
| DADS Postes (INSEE) | Matched employer–employee panel, all French establishments | CASD |
| FARE / FICUS (INSEE–DGFiP) | Firm financial statements | CASD |
| GASPAR (Géorisques) | CatNat ministerial disaster declarations | Public |
| JRC flood hazard maps (Dottori et al.), TRI, ONRN EAIP | Flood-depth rasters and flood-prone areas | Public |

: Data sources and access {#tbl-access}

The full manifest — files, vintages, and download locations — is in the repository's
[`data/README.md`](https://github.com/andreasalem/floods_france/blob/main/data/README.md).

## Code: two tracks, two guarantees

**`code/casd_export_2025-07/`** is the exact code that produced the thesis results, exported
from the CASD secure enclave on 2025-07-09 and kept byte-frozen as the provenance record — a
19-script R + Stata pipeline whose main specification is LP-DiD (Dube–Girardi–Jordà–Taylor)
via Stata's `lpdid`.

**`code/pipeline/`** is a clean R rewrite in progress: numbered scripts, portable paths,
`renv`-pinned. The public-data stages — the GASPAR flood treatment and the flood-risk raster
exposure measures — run end-to-end outside the enclave and are verified against the thesis
figures. The confidential-data stages are faithful rewrites that carry an explicit
verification status until they can be checked against the frozen export inside CASD.

The honest status of every reproducibility claim is maintained in the repository's
[README](https://github.com/andreasalem/floods_france#reproducibility-honestly-stated).
